card.title: AID TO THE FRONT
card.text: Give a unit with two or more combat keywords +2+2.
card.flavorText: On 23 August 1944, King Michael of Romania led a dramatic coup that reshaped the Eastern Front. With support from a coalition of opposition parties and the Romanian Communist underground, he ordered the arrest of the leader of the Romanian government, Marshal Ion Antonescu, and announced an immediate armistice with the Allies. The decision came as Soviet forces broke through Axis lines in northeastern Romania. The Red Army’s advance was swift. Romanian units, previously allied with Germany, began cooperating with Soviet troops. Within days, German forces faced coordinated resistance from their former Romanian allies. Over 130,000 German troops were taken prisoner during the subsequent operations. Romania’s defection allowed the Soviet Union to secure vital oil fields and open a direct path into the Balkans. It also forced Germany to divert resources at a critical moment. In return, the Soviets promised support to Romania’s new government, dominated by King Michael but increasingly influenced by communists. The coup in Bucharest was one of the most consequential political reversals of the war. It transformed Romania from an Axis ally into an active contributor to the Allied cause on the Eastern Front.
